effects.notes: If you have no minor improvements in front of you, gain 1 food at the start of each round.
If you have no minor improvements in front of you, gain 1 wood at the start of each harvest.

unresolved_fields: effects[0].conditions: predicate 'minor_improvement_count' is not in the vocabulary; no existing predicate expresses 'no minor improvements in front of the owner' ('improvement_count' counts minor+major together) and the at-least convention of count predicates would make {n:0} trivially true, inverting the intended condition; the engine implements the check directly (StartRoundGainIfNoMinorPlayed), so the effect is confirmed and only the spec-side predicate is undefined
effects[1].conditions: same for the harvest-start trigger (engine: HarvestFieldGainIfNoMinorPlayed)
review.notes: While you have no minor improvements, gain 1 food at each round start and 1 wood at each harvest start. Minor improvements passed to left neighbor no longer count as 'in front of you'.
